verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird has a dedicated Employee Incentives and Benefits practice page stating it advises clients 'from start-ups to multi-nationals on incentives issues'. The page also offers downloadable factsheets on UK EMI, Growth Shares, Company Share Option Plans and Share Incentive Plans, so the core of the story, employee equity schemes described on the firm's own pages, is evidenced. Missing for 10: German VSOP/ESOP coverage, Indian ESOP coverage, explicit description of plan design (rather than general advice), and independent corroboration.
